summary: Began implementing seven thread-view polish items from screenshot_01.png. Removed the 'Thread' eyebrow, lined up the conversation header baseline with the inspector header via shared h1/h2 styles, and matched the header's top-corner rounding to the folder-tab look. Extended the protocol and event translator to carry per-message `completedAt`/turn-end timestamps, added a `stampTurnEnds` pass in `session-transcript.ts`, and exposed a `turnStart(messages)` helper in `streaming.ts` so UI can compute total agent run time. Also clarified two open questions with the user (rounding target = folder-tab look; thread-name model = configurable setting).
decisions: Thread header top corners get `border-radius: var(--radius-sm) var(--radius-sm) 0 0` to match the folder-tab look (instead of any inspector-specific radius).
Conversation header and inspector header share the same `[data-ui='conversation-header'] h1, [data-ui='inspector-header'] h2` rule so their baselines align.
The 'Thread' eyebrow span in the conversation header is removed; the title alone is the thread header.
Thread name generation will be driven by a configurable 'title model' setting (defaulting to a cheap one), not the same model used for commit messages or a hard-coded free model.

Timing/total-run-time support: add `completedAt?: number` to `message.completed` events and a `turnEnd` field on assistant messages, then expose `turnStart(messages)` on the client to compute total elapsed time for the current turn.
Per-turn duration shown after the final agent message will be derived from the existing `createdAt`/`turnEnd` timestamps on assistant messages; no separate timer stream is introduced.
For the running-agent total-time indicator at the top of the page, the implementation will use the same `turnStart` helper rather than the current tool/thinking-local timer.
